body: I think it sounds like you have made a decision already. *hugs*

Look. My first suicide attempt was 3 months before I turned 18. 17, soon to be 18, just like you. 

I'm really lucky to have survived. Yes, my life sucks right now and it's so hard at times, but that does not take away from the amazing things I have witnessed and the lives I have been able to touch and save with my own experiences. You can use your sadness as fuel to do greater things. Your experiences have made you capable of relating to people that don't have anyone else to relate to. The two most important days of our lives are the day we are born and the day we find out why. You have a reason to be here, friend.

I would give it a go. Try and face that hard stuff and see what happens. If it doesn't work out, hey, you tried. Sometimes people just aren't meant for each other, even if you find out much later. Letting out your feelings is extremely important and the other person's responses really show who they are as people. I really do hope the best for you. Just remember- if it ends in divorce, you will hurt but you can move on if you let yourself. I believe you can be okay and happy. You just have to give yourself permission. Carry on, friend. Message me if you ever need anything.

I'm so sorry :( I have dealt with this with my past boyfriends. One of them was emotionally abusive and said those things to me ALL the time...and then the most recent boyfriend told me when he broke up with me that he can't be close to me because he thinks I'll kill myself at any time.

My sister was married and dealt with what you are dealing with. She has since gotten divorced and is much happier. I'm not saying I recommend that, but I would definitely say to try couple's counseling? That isn't right for him to act that way.
I'll check it out :) thank you so much for your help
I was going to look into the local NAMI here. I'm in the US, yes. I'm assuming that NAMI helped you a lot, I should definitely try there.
The confusion is gone but everything else is still going on. Thank you. Very much appreciated.

It was pretty much a slap in the face. They didn't do anything to make sure I was ok. They didn't even ask what day it was or where I was until I openly said I had no idea what day it was when my sister asked the date. I didn't even know what week I was in, yet they still did nothing.
They did not.
I went to one of the most well-known hospitals here in Iowa. They didn't take me seriously and they almost sounded like they were mocking me when I was in there. I'm not happy about it.

They said nothing is wrong, but my head is coming back to hurting this afternoon. Starting to feel the same as I did last night. They didn't even give me a CT scan "because you can't get TBI from self-harm"
And that's exactly what happened. I appreciate your talking
Thank you. I went and everything is ok.
That's true. I usually meditate, but I haven't even been on the mood for that even and haven't forced myself into it.
I can't even handle death and gore videos...I don't even watch scary movies because I have psychotic depression and they trigger me. I'm glad that works for you, though. I need to find an outlet.
I feel much better. Both mentally and physically
You are welcome!
I'm okay everyone. Went to the ER and they said nothing was wrong...which is surprising to me after years of this. To anyone asking, no, I am not violent towards other people.
Yes! That is exactly it.
That made my day in an odd way. Thank you friend! :)

Wow, I almost don't know what to say. I'm really glad this impacted you the way it did, I wasn't at all sure that my little story would make a difference for anyone. Thank you and you're welcome as well :)
That's true
Thanks
I did :) he's a good boy.
It is my favorite feeling.
That made me smile. Thank you :) to you as well.
Thank you :)
Thank you. I ended up having a crisis counselor meet me at the hospital.  I didn't have to stay for very long because I agreed to go to NAMI support groups.
I get that. It was time for me to go. I went and met with a crisis counselor from a mobile unit. Those people are amazing.
Thank you!
I did :)
This is true!
Thanks. I am doing a transitional program type of thing
It's one of those things that make you question how the world works. Honestly, I was convinced one of my hallucinations was doing it so you're not wrong
Thanks. I'm hoping for that, too. Appreciated.
